data.narrative:
Andrenam is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Matej Cernosek and Alex Chu that has raised $18M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of ten companies in the Defense & Security sector: two public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private companies including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, and Anduril Industries.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $18M total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to next stage, yielding $36M. The Peer-Median method examines four same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations of $4.0B (Stark Defence), $1.0B (Castelion), $400M (Singularity), and $125M (NODA AI). The median across this four-company cohort is $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B, reflecting significant dispersion in early-stage defense tech valuations.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $31M (low) to $805M (high), with a median estimate of $368M across the two methods. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate multiples in a sector where comparable companies exhibit valuations spanning nearly two orders of magnitude. Key variables affecting valuation include customer concentration, technical differentiation, and regulatory pathway clarity—factors not fully captured in peer multiples alone.
